Meta.title: The Living Kitchen
Meta.description: Tell the kitchen what you have and watch dinner appear.

Home.headline: What's in your kitchen?
Home.lede: Add what you have. We'll turn it into something warm and delicious.

Tonight.button: {meal, select, breakfast {What's for breakfast?} lunch {What's for lunch?} snack {What's for a snack?} dessert {What's for dessert?} other {What's for dinner?}}
Tonight.hint: One tap. Nani picks from your pantry ({count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}).
Tonight.hintEmpty: One tap. Nani picks something simple to cook.

Dock.label: Add ingredients
Dock.hint: Press Enter or a comma to add. Quantities are optional.
Dock.empty: Your counter is empty. Add something tasty.
Dock.unknown: New to us, we'll still use it
Dock.full: That's a full counter (40 items max).
Dock.modeLabel: How do you want to start?
Dock.dishHint: Nani writes the whole recipe: what you'll need and every step. Anything on your counter or in your pantry is ticked as ready.
Dock.dishTooShort: Type the name of a dish or drink.
Dock.leftoversHint: Tap what's left from yesterday. Nani turns it into something new.

Prefs.title: Preferences
Prefs.description: Tell Nani how you like to eat. These are saved on this device.
Prefs.cookwareHint: Leave empty to assume a gas stove and basic pots.
Prefs.mealAuto: Picked from the time of day unless you choose one.

Results.title: Fresh out of the pot
Results.subtitle: Three ideas from your counter. Pick one to open it.

kinds.almost_there: {count, plural, =0 {Almost there} one {Need # item} other {Need # items}}

Error.title: Oops, the pot boiled over.
Error.rateLimited: That's a lot of cooking! Give the kitchen a few minutes to cool down.
Error.upstream: The AI kitchen is very busy right now. Give it a moment and try again.
Error.invalid_output: The recipes came out a little lumpy. Let's try that again.
Error.refused: Nani couldn't help with that combination. Try changing your ingredients.
Error.config: The kitchen's AI isn't set up correctly. Check the API key in .env.local.
Error.bad_request: Some of those ingredients or preferences look off. Try editing them.

Recipe.addAllMissing: Add missing items to shopping list
Recipe.allMissingAdded: Missing items are on your list
Recipe.noSubstitutes: No swaps known for this one yet.
Recipe.nutritionSummary: {calories} kcal per serving: {protein} g protein, {carbs} g carbs, {fat} g fat, {fibre} g fibre.

CookMode.title: Cook Mode
CookMode.swipeHint: Swipe or use ← → to move between steps
CookMode.doneBody: Plate it up while it's hot. Enjoy every bite.
CookMode.ingredientsFor: For {count, plural, one {# serving} other {# servings}}
CookMode.timerAdd: Add a minute to the {label} timer
CookMode.voiceUnsupported: Voice control isn't available in this browser.
CookMode.voiceDenied: Microphone access was blocked, so voice control is off.
CookMode.notFoundTitle: This recipe isn't on this device
CookMode.notFoundBody: Cook Mode opens recipes you've started in this browser. Cook something in the kitchen first.
CookMode.sayLastStep: That's the last step. After it, you serve.
CookMode.sayHelp: You can say: next, back, repeat, go to step 3, what's next, timer for 5 minutes, stop timer, how much time is left, or ingredients.
CookMode.sayMinSec: {min, plural, =0 {} one {# minute} other {# minutes}} {sec, plural, =0 {} one {# second} other {# seconds}}

Voice.nothing: I didn't catch any ingredients. Tap the mic and try again.
Voice.noSpeech: I didn't hear anything. Tap the mic and try again.
Voice.denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser's site settings to use voice.
Voice.unsupported: Voice input isn't available in this browser. Try Chrome, Edge or Safari, or type instead.
Voice.error: Voice input stopped unexpectedly. Tap the mic to try again.

Scan.buttonLabel: Scan your fridge or pantry from a photo
Scan.title: Fridge scan
Scan.found: {count, plural, =0 {I couldn't spot any ingredients} one {I spotted # thing} other {I spotted # things}}
Scan.fewHint: Anything else? You can add more by typing or try another photo.
Scan.noneHint: The photo may be too dark or blurry. Try another one in good light, closer to the shelves.
Scan.reviewHint: Tap to choose what goes on the counter. Unsure guesses start unticked.
Scan.addSelected: {count, plural, =0 {Add selected} one {Add # ingredient} other {Add # ingredients}}
Scan.privacy: Your photo isn't stored. It's shrunk on your device, sent once to spot ingredients, then thrown away.
Scan.tooBig: That file isn't a photo we can read. Try a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
Scan.failed: The scan didn't work this time.

Account.title: Sign in to sync
Account.lede: Keep your pantry, saved recipes and shopping list on every device. We'll email you a magic link, so there's no password to remember.
Account.sentDetail: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device to finish signing in.
Account.invalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
Account.guestNote: Everything you've saved as a guest comes with you when you sign in.
Account.unavailable: Accounts aren't set up on this site yet. Your pantry, book and list are kept on this device.
Account.callbackFailed: That sign-in link didn't work. It may have expired or been opened in another browser.
Account.offline: Offline: changes will sync when you're back

Pantry.title: My pantry
Pantry.lede: The staples you always have. Turn on “Use my pantry” in the kitchen and they're part of every recipe.
Pantry.empty: Your pantry shelf is empty. Add the basics you always keep.
Pantry.useInCookingHint: {count, plural, =0 {Your pantry is empty} one {Adds # pantry item to every recipe} other {Adds # pantry items to every recipe}}

UseItUp.nudge: Your {name} expires {when}. Here are 3 ideas to use it up.
UseItUp.nudgeMany: {name} and {count, plural, one {# more thing} other {# more things}} expire soon. Cook something to use them up.

Book.title: Recipe book
Book.lede: Every recipe you've saved, with your notes and ratings.
Book.empty: No saved recipes yet. Tap the heart on any recipe to keep it here.
Book.notesPlaceholder: Less chilli next time, add a squeeze of lemon…
Book.photoNeedsAccount: Sign in to add a photo of your dish.

List.title: Shopping list
List.lede: Missing ingredients from your recipes, grouped by aisle.
List.empty: Your list is empty. Missing ingredients you add from a recipe show up here.
List.left: {count, plural, =0 {All done!} one {# to buy} other {# to buy}}

Daypart.label: Time of day
Daypart.button: Kitchen light: {part}{mode, select, auto { (following your clock)} other {}}
Daypart.autoHint: Morning, golden hour or night, by the time

Share.title: Share this recipe
Share.noLink: Links need the site's account service, so you can share the picture instead.
Share.failed: The link couldn't be made right now. You can still share the picture.
Share.text: {title}: a recipe from The Living Kitchen
Share.cardFooter: Cooked up at The Living Kitchen
Share.pageTitle: A recipe from The Living Kitchen
Share.pageLede: Shared from someone's counter. Cook it, save it, or make it your own.
Share.notFoundBody: The link may be mistyped, or the recipe was never shared.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.lede: How your kitchen looks, sounds and cooks. Saved on this device.
Settings.languageHint: Recipes are written in this language too.
Settings.dietHint: Every recipe follows this. More choices are in the kitchen's preferences.
Settings.qualityHint: Auto picks what this device handles smoothly. Off shows a still picture instead.
Settings.privacyGuest: Everything is saved only on this device: your counter, pantry, saved recipes, shopping list and settings.
Settings.privacySignedIn: Your pantry, saved recipes and shopping list are also kept in your account ({email}), so they sync between your devices.
Settings.privacyPhotos: Fridge-scan photos are never stored. A “Made it!” photo is stored only if you add one to a saved recipe.
Settings.privacyAi: To write recipes, your ingredients and preferences are sent to an AI service, without anything that identifies you.
Settings.exportFailed: Couldn't fetch your account's data just now. Please try again.
Settings.deleteGuest: This clears your counter, pantry, saved recipes, shopping list and settings from this device. It can't be undone.
Settings.deleteAccount: This deletes your account ({email}) and everything in it, including photos, and clears this device. It can't be undone.
Settings.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete your data just now. Please try again.
Settings.deleted: All your data has been deleted.

NotFound.title: This page isn't in the kitchen
NotFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped. Everything else is right where you left it.
